description: This file defines a custom Android View called CardMatchView that manages and displays a card matching game (Memory). It constructs a grid layout of buttons representing cards, handles user interactions, maintains game state, and communicates with a game manager (CardMatchManager). The view supports saving/restoring state and provides callbacks for metrics updates and accessibility announcements.

classes.name: CardMatchView
classes.description: A custom Android view for a card matching game, built using GridLayout and Buttons, managing game interactions and rendering.

methods.name: setOnMetricsChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a callback invoked when game metrics (moves, matched pairs) change.

methods.name: setOnAnnounceListener
methods.description: Sets a callback for accessibility messages, such as updates or prompts.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Restarts the game, rebuilding the grid and resetting game state.

methods.name: exportState
methods.description: Exports the current game state for saving during configuration changes.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores a previously saved game state.
